scientific_purpose: Validate the domain-of-validity monitor with a supported-condition specificity test and a genuinely prospective condition-shift test.

development_only_rule.inputs: The 32 empirical-Bayes gain vectors already recorded in JCP6R from eight Mach-8/Mach-10 development seeds and four draws per seed.
development_only_rule.components_definition: Nine physical components (n, u, v, T, Pxx, Pxy, Pyy, qn, qt) in three fixed spatial zones (near wall, wake, outer).
development_only_rule.unit_score: Fraction of component gains exceeding componentwise maxima estimated without the held-out development seed.
development_only_rule.calibration: Leave-one-development-seed-out; the alpha=0.10 finite-sample upper conformal rank for eight units is the maximum of the eight held-out unit scores.
development_only_rule.deployment_score: Fraction of the 27 gains exceeding the full-development componentwise maxima.
development_only_rule.decision: Accept the structured prediction when the deployment score is at or below the frozen threshold; otherwise abstain.

heldout_Mach10_specificity.reference_access: No reference-partner file is read by the specificity calculation.
heldout_Mach10_specificity.pass_rule: At least five of six supported-condition observations are accepted.

fresh_Mach12_evaluation.seed_selection: All four predeclared seeds are retained when mechanically complete; stationarity diagnostics are reported and are not used for replacement.
fresh_Mach12_evaluation.chronology: The rule lock and Mach-10 specificity archive are created before the Slurm evaluation array is submitted. Prediction and support decisions are locked before the score job may open a reference artifact.
fresh_Mach12_evaluation.pass_rule: All four fresh Mach-12 observations trigger abstention.

reference_reuse.reason_no_new_reference_DSMC: The independent JCP8 Mach-12 reference already contains four 40-block seeds. JCP11 uses only the two previously held-out seeds 26082803 and 26082804, for 80 blocks, and opens them only after the fresh decision lock.

primary_monitor_gate: Accept at least five of six held-out Mach-10 observations and abstain on all four fresh Mach-12 observations.
reporting: Accuracy against the reference is a post-lock diagnostic. It cannot alter the support threshold, seed set, component envelope, or decisions.

block_accounting_clarifications.development_vs_prospective_Mach10: Each Mach-10 development seed archived 40 blocks. The later prospective Mach-10 confirmation is a different six-pair campaign with a locked 17-output NOUT 100-116 window.
block_accounting_clarifications.LOSO_partition: Within each 40-block development unit, B3 is a subset of B10; the disjoint 30-block reference is the complement of B10. Thus the accounting is 10+30=40, not 3+10+30. Leave-one-seed-out refers to construction of the same-Mach prior from the three peer seeds.
